title: breathing-plate — one modest image with a fixed proportion of empty band around it
idea: One image at modest size, centred, with a large and fixed proportion of empty band around it and a single caption line beneath. The air is the composition.
why_new: an image today is either the whole band or a column of a split, and both fill their space. There is no register where a single picture is given room, so every gallery, studio and portfolio site presents work at maximum density.
built_from: one constrained group, one image at a capped width, one caption. The simplest entry here after quote-band, and it needs no new CSS.
risk: it reads as unfinished unless the empty space is a fixed proportion of the band rather than whatever the content leaves over — the same failure mode as the quiet hero. Cap at one or two per page, and it must survive a short viewport without the plate filling the screen.
